Hi team,

I'm starting the logistics for the upcoming annual performance cycle. Goal is to launch manager calibration and reviews in late July and complete final ratings by end of August. This thread is sensitive — please do not forward outside leadership and People Ops until we finalize.

Key asks in this draft:
- Review attached Performance_Review_Form_v2.docx and highlight any missing competencies by EOD Monday (6/16).
- Confirm calibration meeting slots for the week of 7/21 — I suggested 7/22 and 7/24 in the shared roster (see attached Calibration_Roster_2025.xlsx).
- Approve the manager communications draft (manager_comms_draft.txt). This will be the confidential manager-only email to kick off the process.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- 6/12-6/20: Manager form review + HR sign-off on template and scoring rubric
- 6/23-7/11: Managers collect self-reviews and upward feedback (optional)
- 7/14-7/18: Manager review period / submit preliminary ratings in review portal
- 7/21-7/25: Calibration meetings (division-level)
- 7/28-8/08: Finalize ratings and comp recommendations
- 8/11-8/29: Manager-employee conversations and documentation

Risks and notes:
- We need a clear escalation path for sensitive cases (probation, terminations, salary exceptions). Markus, can you confirm who should be looped for approvals beyond leadership?
- We should lock down the review form fields that surface protected characteristics to avoid bias. Helena from People Ops is copied on the later thread; I will loop her after we align here.

Attachments: Performance_Review_Form_v2.docx (docx), Calibration_Roster_2025.xlsx (xlsx), manager_comms_draft.txt (txt).

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Director, GTM Operations

Appreciate the thorough draft, Monica. A few leadership decisions: 
1) Escalation path: for any proposed salary uplift > 10% or role changes that alter job band, route to me + Finance (Chloe Martin) + People Ops (Helena). For terminations or probationary actions, loop Legal and People Ops immediately.
2) Calibration attendance: require managers plus one peer reviewer where available; sessions will be 60 minutes and led by division leads. I'll chair Sales/Go-to-Market calibrations.
3) Confidentiality: label all manager comms as "Manager Confidential" and circulate through the internal portal rather than broadcast email.

Please lock the timeline — we need a two-week buffer between calibration and finalization to allow comp committee review.

Markus
